name: qa-tools
description: Native Mistral Vibe CLI plugins for test automation: skills, subagents, knowledge and quality-gate hooks (Agent Plugins 1.0 format).

scripts.check: node scripts/build.ts --check && node scripts/lint-all-packs.ts && node scripts/check-changelog.ts && node scripts/check-bundles-duplicates.ts && node scripts/lint-command-skill-pairs.ts && node scripts/lint-eval-suites.ts && node scripts/lint-host-leaks.ts && node scripts/token-budget-audit.ts --check
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run validate-manifests && npm run lint && npm run verify && npm test
scripts.p2: npm run changelog:preview && npm run readme:stats:check && npm run links:check
scripts.p2:all: npm run changelog && npm run readme:stats && npm run links
scripts.test:p3: node --test scripts/validate-links.test.ts scripts/generate-changelog.test.ts scripts/update-readme-stats.test.ts scripts/lint-command-skill-pairs.test.ts scripts/lint-eval-suites.test.ts scripts/lint-host-leaks.test.ts scripts/token-budget-audit.test.ts
scripts.p4: npm run security:scan && npm run flaky:check && npm run benchmark
scripts.test:all:p4: npm run test:all && npm run test:p4
scripts.p5: npm run quarantine:detect && npm run security:enforce && npm run perf:check
scripts.test:all:p5: npm run test:all:p4 && npm run test:p5
